item.title: Films and books
item.description: Talking about stories, characters and reviews.

children.definition: the series of events that make up a story
children.example: The plot was hard to follow, but the acting was great.

children.definition: a person in a book, film or play
children.example: The main character is a young doctor in Bukhara.

children.definition: an article that gives an opinion about a new film, book or show
children.example: The film got very good reviews.

children.definition: the way that a story finishes
children.example: I didn't expect the ending at all.

children.definition: a part of a film or play that happens in one place
children.example: The first scene takes place at a railway station.

children.definition: the person who controls how a film is made and tells the actors what to do
children.example: The director also wrote the script.

children.definition: to make a film, song or book available for people to see or buy
children.example: Their new album will be released in May.

children.definition: using a real event or another story as the starting point
children.example: The series is based on a true story.

children.definition: to say that something is good and that someone should try it
children.example: Can you recommend a good book for the summer?

children.definition: words at the bottom of the screen that show or translate what people are saying
children.example: I watch English films with English subtitles.

children.definition: a set of TV programmes with the same characters or subject
children.example: We watched the whole series in one weekend.

children.definition: the people who watch or listen to a film, play or concert
children.example: The audience laughed all through the play.
